A FEW HELPFUL ANSWERS

Before you
say hello.

Is this salon only for ladies?+

Yes. Anjali Super Salon and Training Centre is exclusively for ladies, including its beauty training enquiries.

Can I enquire about bridal makeup?+

Yes. Choose Bridal makeup and share your event date, preferred look and questions. The salon will discuss availability and pricing with you.

Do you offer makeup and haircut training?+

Yes. Ask about makeup artistry, haircut and styling, or beauty and salon essentials. Confirm the current syllabus, fees, batch availability and duration directly with the centre.

Does sending an enquiry confirm my booking?+

No. WhatsApp opens with your enquiry; the salon will reply to confirm the appointment or training details.

Where is the salon?+

The salon is in Abhayapuri, Assam. Ask on WhatsApp for the exact address and directions before your visit.
